mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN points_type = 1 THEN points WHEN points_type = 2 THEN -points ELSE 0 END ), 0) as total_points FROM user_points WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id, points, points_type, source, description, balance, created_time FROM user_points WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.points, up.points_type, up.source, up.description, up.balance, up.created_time, vu.username, vu.real_name FROM user_points up LEFT JOIN volunteer_user vu ON up.user_id = vu.id
AND vu.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND vu.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND up.points_type = #{pointsType}
AND up.source LIKE CONCAT('%', #{source}, '%')
ORDER BY up.created_time DESC
